semiconductor_relevance: High — Piotech Inc. is directly involved in the production of advanced film deposition equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Piotech Inc. develops and produces advanced film deposition equipment for the ultra-large scale integration (ULSI) industry. The company offers a comprehensive range of deposition process technologies, including CVD, MOCVD, PECVD, LPCVD, ALD, REALD, and MVD, aimed at enhancing nanometer film manufacturing capabilities.
capabilities: Plasma Enhanced Chemical Vapor Deposition (PECVD) systems
